_note: Agent-facing text on main (1.4.0-beta.13), before PR workflows. Graphite mode must keep producing exactly this.
hookBatch: Follow-through batches contain a batch ID and task list. Read workspace_status and refresh live conditions before acting; skip resolved tasks. Process dependent PRs bottom to top, one PR fully before the next. Use the repository's /fix-pr workflow, validate feedback, verify changes, submit through Graphite with --publish, and reply/resolve addressed threads. Follow the repository's safe reparent procedure for merged parents and preserve uncommitted work. For post-deploy tasks, verify the currently serving revision contains every dependency and record behavioral results separately. Acknowledge the header's batch ID with acknowledge_batch before finishing: completed with the result, or blocked with the reason. Verify the entire goal and post-merge work before declare_done; acknowledge a completion batch first. Merging and archiving remain the developer's actions.
mcpBatch: Follow-through batches contain a header with the batchId and ordered tasks. Read workspace_status and refresh live conditions; skip resolved tasks. Process PRs bottom to top, one fully before the next, using the repository's /fix-pr and safe reparent workflow. Validate feedback, verify changes, submit with Graphite --publish, reply/resolve addressed threads and preserve uncommitted work. Post-deploy tasks require verified serving revisions and existing production permissions. Stakeholder update requests are follow-through tasks: retain the original thread, recipient and developer authorization in communication. Use current evidence, distinguish fixed/deployed/verified, and read existing replies before posting. Record the sent replyUrl; a draft or uncertain send stays blocked and must be checked before retrying. Auto authorizes agent delivery only. Acknowledge the header's batchId with acknowledge_batch before finishing (completed with the result, or blocked with the reason), before declare_done for completion batches. Declare Done only after the whole goal and post-merge work are verified. Leave merging and archiving to the developer.

tools.merge: Merge a PR (and its downstack with scope=downstack) through Graphite, using Follow-up's merge plan and blockers. Can't be undone.
tools.enable_merge_when_ready: Turn on Graphite merge-when-ready for a PR, as the PR sheet does.
tools.disable_merge_when_ready: Turn off Graphite merge-when-ready for a PR.
